description: This file initializes the React application, rendering the main App component into the DOM element with id 'root'. It imports React, ReactDOM, a CSS stylesheet, and the App component, and uses ReactDOM.createRoot to mount the application with React.StrictMode for development checks.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering React components into the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the root.
